newsitem.title: USA: IGT and GTECH in gaming pact.
newsitem.headline: IGT and GTECH in gaming pact.

text.p: International Game Technology said Monday it has formed a joint venture with GTECH Holdings Corp unit Dreamport Inc to pursue opportunities in the emerging public video lottery gaming market.

IGT said in a statement the joint venture, to be called IGDreamport, will develop and market video lottery technology, games and services designed to expand the product offerings available to government sponsored lotteries worldwide.

The joint venture agreement provides for a minimum five-year term with options to renew. Management responsibilities, revenues and expenses of the joint venture will be shared equally by the two companies.
